correctness.rationale: Using the source model's density-band characterization, admissible observed densities satisfy \(a_n\phi\le m\le\phi\). For target density \(m_2=b\phi(\cdot-r)\), total variation on the observed space plus missing atom equals the maximum of the positive and negative observed-density discrepancy masses. The monotone Gaussian likelihood ratio crosses the lower and upper admissible ratios once, forcing exactly the two tail discrepancies \(B_{n,b}(r)\) and \(A_b(r)\); pointwise clipping attains both bounds simultaneously. For the critical asymptotic, independent symbolic substitution of \(r=L/\sqrt{2S}\) into the derived upper-tail asymptotic confirms the prefactor \(C_b=\sqrt b L/(4\sqrt\pi)\), and the stated \(-3/2\log\log n\) normalization gives \(nA_b\to e^{-x}\). The lower crossing is much farther into the Gaussian tail, making \(nB_{n,b}\to0\).
